prog='''def transform(grid):
    import numpy as np
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    # locate the large framed block of non-zero rows/cols: contiguous rows/cols containing 1s
    nzr=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if any(v for v in r)]
    # choose the row-range with 1s forming a wide band (rows with >=8 ones)
    band=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if sum(1 for v in r if v==1)>=8]
    r0,r1=min(band),max(band)
    cols=[j for j in range(len(g[0])) if any(g[i][j]==1 for i in range(r0,r1+1))]
    c0,c1=min(cols),max(cols)
    B=[r[c0:c1+1] for r in g[r0:r1+1]]
    h,w=len(B),len(B[0])
    return [[B[j][w-1-i] for j in range(h)] for i in range(w)]
'''
